name: Diksha Polymers Limited
summary: Diksha Polymers Limited manufactures and sells polyethylene terephthalate (PET) bottles/containers, preforms, jars, and caps. Its products are used for storage of beverages, oils, and other ancillary products in various industries, including lubricants, food and beverages, consumer goods, pharmaceuticals, and agrochemicals. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Gwalior, India.
